review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is an ideal role for a recent graduate or some with a couple of years of experience at a wireless carrier and desire to build a career in telecommunications. Continuous Personal and Team Development Desire for continuous self-development and developing skills and expertise across the existing network components and technologies through pursuing certifications such as CompTIA Linux+ and Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA). Desired Expertise & Experience Associate’s, bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or engineering or Telecommunications. Ideally two years working in the telecommunications industry including ideally min two years of experience with a wireless carrier. Candidates who can demonstrate proficiency in Cisco technologies through a current CCNA certification preferred. Physical Requirements Lifting and/or ability to lift 20 lbs.
